taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Egwi (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 295.88 | 0.54518 | 0.54518
2 | 798.6 | 3.5924 | 4.1376
3 | 864.62 | 2.1559 | 6.2935
4 | 1810.2 | 37.957 | 37.25
5 | 5634.2 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Egwi
Curve type: AAA-type (resistivity increases progressively with depth across all layers)
Aquifer depth: 6.29 m – 37.25 m (medium-high resistivity sandy layer, 1810.2 ohm-m)
Recommendation: Target the sandy aquifer horizon between approximately 6 m and 37 m depth for screen placement; case off the shallow lower-resistivity overburden (0–6.3 m) to prevent clay/silt infiltration, and confirm lithology at the base of drilling since the underlying high-resistivity unit (5634.2 ohm-m) may represent a deeper, potentially confined, sand or weathered basement that could serve as a secondary target if yields are insufficient.
